column3: A submitted job carries its own XIN_LOAD/XIN_LIVE values, the runner hands them to the child, and two jobs with different variants do not coalesce
column4: the cache key is computed by the run child, so with the runner's environment deciding both, a XIN_LOAD=1 submission answered by a runner started without it ran the normal suite and reported a pass
column5: while a runner started without XIN_LOAD was alive, `XIN_LOAD=1 bun scripts/gate.ts submit test --only=plugins/web` reported test:pass with the web tests in .gate/test.log; after the change the same submission runs under XIN_LOAD=1, where vitest finds no bench file under plugins/web, and `XIN_LOAD=1 bun scripts/gate.ts submit test` runs test/load.bench.ts
column6: kept; the runner itself is spawned without either variable, and each variant keeps its own cache slot and log, so alternating the suite and the benchmark does not evict either
